Artifacts verified by file existence and small-file SHA256; no DCC re-open or delivery tests.
No deletion candidates: ARCHIVE_CANDIDATE means reversible UI archive only after final manifest review.
All primary chats covered by metadata; source reading remains bounded latest-turn/tail coverage, not exhaustive extraction.
